data.name: Bookmark Hero
data.detailed_description:
Bookmark Hero is a high-fantasy, peripheral-idle RPG set in the vast world of Gamdor. Play from a bookmark-sized window on the side of your screen and command your hero indirectly by giving them queued tasks. Watch as they explore lands, conquer monsters, hone skills, craft gear and weapons, and embark on quests. Even as you work, their legend unfolds.

The world of Arshrein is filled with diverse regions and points of interest. Venture forth to uncover new opportunities, stories, and riches. But be weary. The further your travel, the more dangerous the roads.

Create a hero that fits your style with multiple races, hairstyles, and visual customization options.

Out of the way, but big enough to play

Bookmark Hero is designed to respect your screen real-estate and takes up little room. You can set the bookmark window to be on the left or right side of your screen. It also functions well with multiple display setups.

Queued interaction for minimal distraction

The game is built to be engaging without demanding constant attention. Queue up tasks for your hero, optionally set them to repeat, and let the adventure progress at its own steady rhythm while you stay productive.

Do other things while your hero swings

Whether your hero is chopping wood or fighting goblins, you can stay focused on your own tasks—work, browsing, chatting, or even playing other games—while they carry on with their adventure.

Embark on epic quests

There are many quests to complete in Bookmark Hero. As you level-up your various skills, you'll be able to take on tougher, more legendary quests.

Lots of skills to master

Progress through a wide array of skills, organized into four core categories:

  • Combat: swordsman, ranger, mage

  • Gathering: wood chopping, mining, skinning, foraging

  • Crafting: blacksmithing, leatherwork, tailoring, and more

  • Survival: fishing, cooking, firemaking, and more

Dress to impress

Gear defines both your appearance and your bonuses. Whether you aim to become a master wizard, a hardened warrior, or a precise ranger, crafting and equipping the right items is key to shaping your hero’s strengths.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 or AMD FX-4100
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 4000 or equivalent (any integrated GPU from the last decade)
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4400 or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 Ti, AMD R7 360, or modern integrated GPU (Intel UHD 620+)
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.13 High Sierra
  • Processor: 2.8GHz Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 4000 or Mesa-supported equivalent
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS (latest)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4400 or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 Ti or modern integrated GPU (Intel UHD series)
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

linux_requirements.minimum:

  • Memory: 4 GB RAM

  • Storage: 500 MB available space
